agents.name: Drift Scan Coordinator
agents.description: Routes a scan across every connected source sub-agent, aggregates flagged sections, hands each to the drafter, returns one proposal set

agents.name: Slack Signal Agent
agents.description: Pulls recent messages from scoped channels and summarises decision-bearing statements

agents.name: Drive Signal Agent
agents.description: Pulls recently modified docs in scoped folders and extracts changed factual claims

agents.name: GitHub Signal Agent
agents.description: Reads merged PRs, commit messages and docs changes in scoped repos

agents.name: Jira Signal Agent
agents.description: Reads issue, status and description changes in scoped projects

agents.name: Linear Signal Agent
agents.description: Reads issue and cycle updates in scoped teams since cursor; extracts decision-bearing facts only

agents.name: Drift Detection Agent
agents.description: Compares aggregated normalized facts against page_sections and emits scored findings (contradiction / staleness / gap / confirmation). Never writes prose.

agents.name: Proposal Drafter Agent
agents.description: Downstream of drift detection, not parallel to the source agents. Runs once per deduplicated finding and turns it into a minimal redline, one-line rationale and validated citation.

agents.name: Review Notifier Agent
agents.description: Composes and DMs owners a digest of their pending proposals

agents.name: Verified Answer Agent
agents.description: Answers only from pages in state verified that the asker's role/source-scope permits; every citation is validated against a real page_version before the answer renders.

agents.name: Wiki Import & Section Mapper
agents.description: Splits pasted/uploaded Markdown into sections, suggests an owner and source scopes per section

knowledge_bases.name: Verified Wiki KB
knowledge_bases.description: Holds verified wiki page content for RAG retrieval by the Verified Answer Agent
